baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَوْح at word 2 names an inscription-capable broad surface, while مَحْفُوظ at word 3 predicates guarded preservation of it.
baseline_models.mechanism: A message is externalized onto a stable medium and that medium is placed under continuing custody; legibility and protection cooperate rather than compete.

activation_trace.role: The broad tablet or plank supplies the inscription-bearing material of the model.
Active guarding supplies the custody that keeps the inscribed medium intact.

changed_reading.before: The phrase merely says that the Qur'an is stored somewhere.
changed_reading.after: The phrase depicts an inscription-capable medium whose contents remain under active, entrusted custody.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of لَوْح can image something flashing into view, while the root of مَحْفُوظ can image content fixed against forgetting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase joins disclosure to retention: what becomes perceptible is not exhausted by its appearance but remains held and recoverable.

activation_trace.role: Glinting appearance makes the medium a site from which content can emerge into view.
Retention against forgetting makes each emergence recoverable rather than momentary.

changed_reading.before: Preservation is static concealment in a closed container.
changed_reading.after: Preservation holds a source capable of repeated manifestation without loss to forgetting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَوْح carries an image of an alteration visibly left by heat or exposure, and مَحْفُوظ carries watchful protection from a slip or loss.
baseline_models.mechanism: The preserved object can be read as a surface that has met pressure and nevertheless keeps its trace; preservation is tested integrity, not mere isolation from change.

activation_trace.role: The visible mark left by heat or exposure supplies a material memory of pressure.
Watchful caution supplies resistance to corruption, lapse, or accidental alteration.

changed_reading.before: The tablet is preserved because nothing ever approaches it.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can picture integrity that remains legible through exposure and pressure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The broad plank image of لَوْح can bear or build, and one ح ف ظ branch names a clear road whose trace does not break.
baseline_models.mechanism: The medium is not only a terminal store but a continuity-bearing route: its preserved trace permits content to cross intervals without rupture.

activation_trace.role: The plank's capacity to bear writing or join a structure supplies a transmissive support.
The clear unbroken road turns preservation into continuity of trace across distance.

changed_reading.before: The tablet is the endpoint at which content stops.
changed_reading.after: The tablet can function as a stable route by which a trace remains continuous and transmissible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening elevation and fortified towers project an architectural scale onto the focus pair: the tablet becomes a raised register within a defended order, not a loose writing board.

activation_trace.role: The broad tablet or building plank supplies the material register that can participate in an architecture.
Guarding makes the register a defended component rather than exposed material.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the elevated containing scale.
Fortified towers supply defended segmentation within that elevated order.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a sky characterized by towers and closes by locating the recitation in a guarded tablet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies height, overshadowing, fortification, a broad tablet, and guarding; I transfer the opening architecture to the closing medium. The live alternative is that the oath imagery and tablet remain spatially independent.

changed_reading.before: A small isolated tablet is protected as a discrete object.
changed_reading.after: The tablet reads as a defended register integrated into a larger elevated architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded duration, an appointment fixed to time or place, and the split-root image of counting turn inscription into a temporal warrant: preservation keeps an appointed outcome from lapsing or being miscounted.

activation_trace.role: The writing surface supplies the ledger on which an appointment can be fixed.
The unbroken trace supplies continuity from inscription to the appointed term.
A duration of time supplies the interval across which the record must hold.
An appointment bounded by time or place supplies the record's due point.
The non-dominant mapped image of counting supplies exact enumeration rather than vague futurity.

structural_cues: The promised day precedes the witness pair, so appointment and subsequent attestation form a temporal-evidentiary sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies duration, appointment, counting, inscription, and an unbroken road; I infer that custody guarantees arrival at the due term. The alternative is a simple list of oath objects with no ledger relation.

changed_reading.before: The inscription is preserved only as information about the past.
changed_reading.after: The inscription also functions as a warrant that carries a counted appointment intact toward fulfillment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated witnessing converts retention into evidentiary availability: the tablet keeps events capable of being made present, known, and sign-bearing even after the scene has passed.

activation_trace.role: The inscribable surface supplies an external record for testimony.
Retention against forgetting keeps evidence available beyond immediate observation.
Witness and witnessed supply reciprocal presence between observer and event.
The perpetrators' presence at their own act makes observation itself part of the evidence.
The witnessing sign supplies a durable mark that can attest beyond a single speaker.

structural_cues: ش ه د recurs as a witness-witnessed pair, as the seated perpetrators' role, and as God's relation to every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated presence, observation, signs, inscription, and retention; I infer that the tablet preserves evidentiary presence. The alternative is that each witness occurrence has a separate referent without a shared record mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The tablet keeps events evidentially present, able to confront observer and observed with an enduring sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: Killing beside a cut trench, fueled fire, seated surveillance, and witnessing activate the focus root's heat-mark image. The guarded tablet becomes a counter-surface on which the violent spectacle remains legible when its makers would control what can be seen.

activation_trace.role: A mark left by heat or exposure makes the tablet materially responsive to the fire scene.
Guarding prevents the scene's trace from being erased with its victims.
Taking life supplies the irreversible human event that demands durable registration.
The long deep cut supplies a negative inscription carved into the earth.
Blazing fire and its branding mark connect the trench's violence to visible alteration.
Fuel supplies the maintained material process that produces the heat-mark.
Sitting for surveillance makes the perpetrators managers of an intended spectacle.
Presence with observation supplies the human gaze that the preserved counter-record outlasts.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a cut in earth to fueled fire, stationary observers, and explicit witnessing before ending with a preserved tablet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a trench as cut, fire as branding heat, maintained fuel, observing perpetrators, a heat-mark branch, and guarding; I infer that the closing medium counter-records the spectacle. The alternative is a non-material record with no scar analogy.

changed_reading.before: The tablet protects only the wording of revelation.
changed_reading.after: The guarded tablet also reads as an unerasable counter-surface that preserves the event the fire tried to consume.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human faulting of trust, the assay of persons as metal, intentional work, fitness against corruption, and the passage between danger and deliverance turn the preserved inscription into a stable reference standard by which exposed acts retain their difference.

activation_trace.role: The writing surface supplies an external standard against which acts can remain comparable.
Fixed retention prevents the standard or the distinctions it records from drifting.
Faulting and condemning supply the persecutors' inverted evaluation of the believers.
Settled security and trust supply the quality being falsely treated as a fault.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the testing process that reveals rather than creates quality.
Intentional work supplies conduct that can be tested against the stable standard.
Fitness opposed to corruption supplies the positive distinction retained after testing.
The desert passage poised between rescue and destruction supplies the consequential threshold of the assay.

structural_cues: The persecutors call faith the sole offense; the next contrast assigns fire to unrepentant persecutors and gardens to faithful action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inverted blame, trust, assay, purposeful work, fitness, a perilous threshold, and stable retention; I infer a reference-standard function for the tablet. The alternative is that the tablet preserves text without participating in the moral contrast.

changed_reading.before: The tablet is an archive indifferent to the events narrated before it.
changed_reading.after: The tablet can serve as the stable reference by which persecution cannot permanently rename trust as guilt or corruption as justice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicitly unrealized option of repentance, followed by beginning-and-return, protective forgiveness, and love, revises preservation from frozen state to continuity of identity through possible reversal and restoration.

activation_trace.role: The inscribed medium supplies a stable bearer on which continuity through change can be recognized.
Retention in memory supplies identity that persists across a turn rather than being replaced by it.
Calling another to repentance keeps a real return-path structurally present even when it is refused.
Beginning paired with return supplies one side of a reversible temporal cycle.
Returning after departure supplies restoration without loss of referential identity.
Covering a fault while protecting its bearer supplies a non-annihilating response to guilt.
Love supplies the relational end toward which return can move.

structural_cues: The punishment clause is qualified by failure to repent, and beginning-return is immediately followed by forgiving-loving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a refused return, beginning, return, protective covering, love, and retention; I infer that preservation can maintain identity across restoration. The live alternative is that these divine predicates do not alter the fixed-record sense at all.

changed_reading.before: A preserved record freezes each person into an irreversible recorded state.
changed_reading.after: Preservation can instead secure continuity through a genuine turn: return changes the state without erasing who returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: Taking with force, forming to completion, binding strength, beginning and repeating, doing, and willing make the tablet resemble an operative specification whose preserved trace is continuously carried into action.

activation_trace.role: The writing board supplies a specification that can precede and guide execution.
Steady observance makes preservation an ongoing carrying-out rather than passive storage.
The unbroken road supplies continuity between specification and successive acts.
Taking with force supplies effective intervention rather than mere knowledge.
Forming, repairing, and bringing to completion supply directed process.
Binding a knot or fastening supplies non-slippage in execution.
Beginning together with repetition supplies the opening of an executable cycle.
Return after departure supplies repeatable realization across cycles.
Bringing an act into being supplies the execution itself.
Will and intention supply the directing agency behind execution.

structural_cues: Ayat 12-16 form an uninterrupted series of agentive predicates before the narrative question of 85:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies force, completion, fastening, iterative action, will, observance, and an unbroken route; I infer a specification-to-execution relation. The alternative is that the tablet records action but does not functionally connect to it.

changed_reading.before: The tablet is an inert archive set apart from action.
changed_reading.after: The tablet can be read as a preserved operative pattern whose trace remains continuous as acts begin, recur, and reach completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The news of organized forces arrives and becomes newly present in speech. This activates the tablet as latent memory whose contents can repeatedly emerge as a fresh event of telling without ceasing to be retained.

activation_trace.role: Glinting into view supplies the transition from latent inscription to manifest telling.
Retention in memory keeps the narrated event available for renewed arrival.
Coming or arrival gives news a directed movement toward the hearer.
Speech renewed as report makes an old event newly present in language.
Bringing something out and showing it supplies disclosure from latent storage.
A mutually supporting collective gives the disclosed report organized event-content rather than an isolated datum.

structural_cues: The direct question 'has the news reached you' turns remembered history into a present encounter immediately before the closing contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, renewed report, disclosure, collective event-content, appearance, and memory; I infer that the preserved tablet is a latent source of recurrent present speech. The alternative is ordinary narration with no storage-to-manifestation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Preservation keeps an old report unchanged by sealing it away.
changed_reading.after: Preservation keeps an event latent and recoverable so that it can arrive repeatedly as newly present speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering truth and inhabiting denial are themselves enclosed: the deniers place truth behind visibility, yet they are surrounded, while the Qur'an is located within a guarded tablet. Preservation thus becomes superior containment of the very act that attempts concealment.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and flashing supply truth's capacity to become visible despite attempted covering.
Guarding supplies the outer custody that concealment cannot breach.
Blocking truth supplies the adversarial attempt to prevent manifestation.
Contrariety to truth supplies the enclosing state named by 'in denial.'
Putting a thing behind visibility supplies the spatial tactic of concealment.
Physical encirclement supplies an outer boundary around those attempting to cover truth.
Complete enclosure in knowledge and custody prevents any hidden remainder from escaping the topology.

structural_cues: The closing sequence says the deniers are 'in' denial, then places God around/behind them, then places the glorious Qur'an 'in' a preserved tablet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two في-containments, concealment, behindness, encirclement, guarding, and visibility; I infer a nested topology in which attempted covering is itself contained. The alternative is that the repeated preposition is idiomatic and bears no cross-ayah geometry.

changed_reading.before: The tablet is one isolated container while denial happens outside it.
changed_reading.after: The final sequence nests containers: denial encloses the deniers, divine encompassing encloses them, and guarded inscription encloses the recitation, so attempted covering never reaches an outside from which it could erase the truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and vocal recitation draw content from the stable inscription into repeated performance, while fullness and abundant excellence resist a depleted reading. Preservation includes reproducible enactment, not only remote storage.

activation_trace.role: The writing board supplies the stable inscription from which performance can proceed.
Retention in mind supplies faithful availability during repeated recitation.
Steady observance supplies recurrence as a mode of keeping.
Gathering supplies composition of dispersed units into a recitable whole.
Reading, reciting, and causing to read supply the public enactment of retained content.
Fullness to sufficiency supplies non-depletion across repeated enactments.

structural_cues: The focus prepositional phrase directly follows 'rather, it is a glorious Qur'an,' binding recitable identity to preserved location.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, recitation, fullness, inscription, retention, and observance; I infer that repeated performance is one effect of preservation. The alternative is a purely locative claim with recitation unrelated to the mode of keeping.

changed_reading.before: Preservation means that an inaccessible original remains static elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: A stable original can remain full while its content is repeatedly gathered, remembered, and enacted as recitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the open-air branch is explicitly associated with a different vocalization of لوح, so it must not replace the focus noun's ordinary tablet sense. It remains useful as a form-distant spatial activation because the same focus root, the opening sky, and the raised canopy all converge on an exposed interval held under guard; downstream prose should label it an atmospheric analogy only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to لَوْح at word 2 through its branch inventory and to مَحْفُوظ at word 3 through guarding.

activation_trace.role: The open air between sky and earth supplies an unbounded-seeming medium rather than a solid tablet.
Guarding gives that open interval a protected boundary despite its apparent exposure.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the upper reach of the interval.
A raised canopy supplies a covering edge to the otherwise open medium.

changed_reading.before: The focus medium is imagined only as a compact solid slab.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the medium can expand into the guarded interval between an overshadowing height and the world below.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because the decoy-owl branch is lexically remote from the focus noun and cannot define the tablet. It remains traceable because its rigged visibility combines with seated surveillance, watchful caution, and final enclosure to model disclosure that draws hostile observers into a position where they become visible; downstream prose should present it only as a speculative mechanism, never as translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches to لَوْح at word 2 through the decoy branch and to مَحْفُوظ at word 3 through vigilant keeping.

activation_trace.role: The displayed decoy used to draw down a raptor supplies strategically exposed visibility.
Watchful caution supplies controlled observation around the exposed sign.
Sitting in surveillance supplies hostile observers whose watching also fixes their own position.
Encirclement supplies the boundary within which observers drawn to the sign are disclosed.

changed_reading.before: Manifest revelation is simply a vulnerable object of hostile observation.
changed_reading.after: Speculatively, guarded manifestation can expose the observers themselves by drawing their stance into a larger enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because protective anger is an affective edge of ح ف ظ, whereas مَحْفُوظ ordinarily foregrounds preservation. It remains anchored through that exact focus root and is sharpened by force and severity in 85:12; downstream prose should treat zeal as a coloration of custody, not assign emotion grammatically to the tablet.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَحْفُوظ at word 3 can activate both protective zeal and the keeping of sanctity, while لَوْح at word 2 supplies the protected bearer.

activation_trace.role: The tablet supplies the bearer treated as worthy of defense.
Protective anger and zeal give custody an affective intensity.
Keeping sanctity and covenant identifies what zealous custody defends.
Taking with force supplies the capacity to answer a breach of protected sanctity.
Strength and solidity intensify preservation from neutral storage into defended inviolability.

changed_reading.after: Preservation can carry the force of a sanctuary whose integrity and covenant are zealously defended.

strongest_changes: The trench and fueled fire activate ل و ح as an exposure-mark, making the guarded tablet an unerasable counter-surface to a spectacle of destruction.
The repeated witness root changes retention into evidentiary presence: what passed remains available as a confronting sign.
The final sequence creates nested containment: deniers are in denial and themselves encompassed, while the recitation is in a guarded tablet.
The arrival of renewed news and the gathering of recitation turn static storage into latent content capable of repeated, non-depleting manifestation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus pair holds several tensions at once: solid inscription and flashing appearance, exposure-mark and protection, remote custody and recurrent recitation. Context did not resolve these into one sense; it converted them into coexisting forensic, spatial, temporal, operative, mnemonic, and performative models.
remaining_uncertainties: The architectural transfer from sky and towers to the tablet is coherent but remains analogical rather than syntactically compelled.
The counted-ledger contribution depends on a legitimate but non-dominant split-root mapping for و ع د.
Reading repentance as identity preserved through reversal is abductive and could overconnect adjacent divine predicates.
The open-air and decoy readings are deliberately retained form-distant outliers and must never be rendered as lexical substitutions for لَوْح.
